_doc: The second weapon set as a stance (docs/design/BUILD_DIRECTION.md round 8; it opens at BUILD_UNLOCKS.md's level, taught_builds.json 'stance'). She keeps the same four keys and three auto slots: the stance weapon FLAVORS every key's blows and never turns a skill off (the coordinator's standing ruling), and each stance has a price. mods: what the stance gives and costs while she is in it (stat ids as Sim/Stats.cs Stat; kind flat, inc or more). blow: what her key skills' landed blows carry in it (every: each Nth landed blow; stun seconds on a creature, stagger on a ruler; bleed as a status payload; ward: seconds off her Warding light's recharge, Stat.Block). strike: the swap strike, fired when she swaps INTO this set, on its own internal cooldown so swapping cannot be spammed (radius m around her, damage before her multipliers, grown by her basic attack's rank like a skill's Growth). sets: set A's own swap strike, by calling (set A is her calling weapon: no flavor, no price). Read by Content/Stances.cs; run by Sim/Stance.cs. StanceTests hold that every stance costs something set A does not pay, gives something set A lacks, and that none is better than another on every axis.

stances.name: Bulwark
stances.flavor: Her blows block and stun: each landed blow brings her Warding light back sooner, and every third stuns.

stances.name: Twin Fangs
stances.flavor: Her blows come faster and bleed.

stances.flavor: Her blows stagger: they hit harder and throw them, and every second one rocks them on their feet.
